Title: Login succeeds with valid credentials and lands on the product catalogue
Precondition: Signed out; on login.html; registered account qa@shoplite.test / Passw0rd!23.
Steps:
1. Enter qa@shoplite.test into Email
2. Enter Passw0rd!23 into Password
3. Click Login
4. Observe the resulting page and the header
Expected Result: User is signed in; lands on products.html with a session established; header shows the signed-in user's name and a cart badge.
Actual Result:
PASS for the all-lowercase email.
FAIL for any case variant — QA@ShopLite.test was rejected, matching BUG-012.
Notes / Matching Bugs: The exact-case happy path works; §2.2 case-insensitivity is separately tracked.

Title: Failed sign-in shows the same neutral message for unregistered email and wrong password
Steps:
1. Enter nobody@example.com and whatever123; click Login. Read the error.
2. Clear; enter qa@shoplite.test and WrongPass1!; click Login. Read the error.
3. Compare the two messages character-for-character.
Test Data:
Pair 1 = nobody@example.com / whatever123
Pair 2 = qa@shoplite.test / WrongPass1!
Expected Result:
Both failures display the exact same message: "Email or password is incorrect."
Identical wording, length, and styling in both cases.
Actual Result: FAIL — Different messages were shown for each case; the account-existence state is revealed.

Title: Search returns matching products for a lowercase query and updates the count
Precondition: Signed in; on products.html; no filters applied.
Steps:
1. Type pulse into the Search field.
2. Read the grid and the result count.
3. Type PULSE and read the grid and the result count.
4. Type  pulse  (with spaces) and read the grid and the result count.
Test Data:
Queries:
• pulse
• PULSE
•  pulse  (with leading/trailing spaces)
Expected Result: All three return Pulse X5 Phone and Pulse Lite Phone; count reads "Showing 2 of 8 products"; no leading/trailing whitespace issues.
Actual Result:
FAIL — The lowercase and whitespace variants did not match; the count stayed at "Showing 8 of 8 products" for all three.
Matches BUG-019 and BUG-020.
Notes / Matching Bugs: Positive intent (valid query should match) fails for the same reason as the negative test (case sensitivity).

Title: Out-of-stock product's button is disabled and cannot add to the cart
Precondition: Signed in; cart empty; on products.html.
Steps:
1. Locate Type-C Hub 7-in-1 (button reads "Out of stock").
2. Click the Out of stock button once.
3. Read the cart badge and open cart.html.
Expected Result: Button is disabled and non-interactive; no request fired; badge unchanged; no cart line created.
Actual Result: FAIL — Clicking the out-of-stock button added units to the cart; badge increased and a cart line appeared.

Title: Add one unit of an in-stock product and verify the cart line, badge, and line total
Precondition: Signed in; cart empty; on products.html.
Steps:
1. Click Add to cart once on Echo Buds Pro (৳5,499).
2. Read the header cart badge.
3. Open cart.html and inspect the line for Echo Buds Pro — quantity, unit price, line total.
Expected Result:
Badge = 1
One cart line
Quantity = 1
Unit price read-only at ৳5,499.00
Line total = ৳5,499.00

Title: Quantity field rejects 0, negative, decimal, blank, and non-numeric input
Precondition: Signed in; cart contains one Echo Buds Pro line at quantity 1; on cart.html.
Steps:
1. Enter 0 and commit; read quantity and any error.
2. Enter -1 and commit.
3. Enter 1.5 and commit.
4. Clear the field (blank) and commit.
5. Enter abc and commit.
Expected Result: Inline error for every invalid value; previous valid quantity (1) restored each time; line total and subtotal unchanged.
Actual Result: FAIL — 0, -1, and 1.5 were accepted; blank and abc did not restore the previous valid quantity; totals recalculated with invalid values.

Title: Clear cart asks for confirmation and clears coupon and discount on confirm
Precondition: Signed in; cart has at least two items; coupon SAVE10 applied and discount line visible; on cart.html.
Steps:
1. Note the discount value and grand total.
2. Click Clear cart.
3. Observe whether a confirmation prompt appears.
4. If a cancel option exists, cancel and verify cart unchanged.
5. Click Clear cart again and confirm.
6. Inspect cart lines, coupon field, discount line, subtotal, grand total.
Expected Result:
Confirmation required.
On confirm:
• Cart emptied
• Coupon and discount cleared
• Subtotal ৳0.00
Actual Result: FAIL — No confirmation shown; cart cleared on first click; coupon and discount remained populated.

Title: SAVE10 discount is capped at ৳2,000 and applied correctly on a qualifying cart
Precondition: Signed in; cart subtotal ≥ ৳20,000 (so 10% exceeds the cap); no coupon applied; on cart.html.
Steps:
1. Enter SAVE10 and click Apply.
2. Read the Discount line.
3. Read the Grand total and compare to (subtotal − discount) + VAT + delivery.
Expected Result:
Discount line = ৳2,000.00 exactly
Grand total = (subtotal − 2,000) + 7.5% VAT + delivery, rounded to 2 decimals.
Actual Result: FAIL — Discount far exceeded ৳2,000; grand total did not match the formula; VAT did not recalculate.

Title: Payment method is single-choice: choosing cash on delivery deselects card and hides card fields
Precondition: Signed in; cart has at least one item; on checkout.html.
Steps:
1. Select Credit / debit card; confirm card fields are shown.
2. Select Cash on delivery.
3. Observe which of the two is selected and whether the card fields are hidden.
4. Try to click the selected option again to deselect it.
Expected Result:
Exactly one option selected.
Card fields hidden on cash selection and no longer required.
The selected option cannot be deselected to an empty state.
Actual Result: FAIL — Both options remained selected; the selected option could not be deselected.

Title: A fully valid checkout places exactly one order and matches the cart grand total
Precondition: Signed in; cart has one or more items and a known grand total; on cart.html; no coupon or a single valid coupon applied.
Steps:
1. Note the cart grand total.
2. Proceed to checkout.
3. Fill full name, mobile number, street address, city.
4. Select Credit / debit card; enter a valid card number, valid future expiry, and a 3-digit CVV.
5. Tick the terms checkbox.
6. Click Place order once.
7. Read the order reference and amount charged.
8. Reload the confirmation page.
Test Data:
Luhn-valid 13–19 digit card
Future MM/YY expiry
3-digit CVV
Terms ticked
Expected Result:
Exactly one order created.
Amount charged = cart grand total.
Cart emptied.
Confirmation persisted and not forgeable by URL editing.
Actual Result:
FAIL — Multiple upstream defects blocked a clean end-to-end run:
• Mandatory fields accepted blank (BUG-005)
• Mobile number accepted invalid formats (BUG-008)
• Card length/Luhn not enforced (BUG-007, BUG-009)
• CVV accepted a negative value (BUG-003)
• Terms did not gate submission (BUG-002)
• Amount payable did not match cart grand total (BUG-039)
Notes / Matching Bugs: End-to-end chain; each upstream failure tracked under its own ticket.
